subject: Convert query struct scan fields to gormtype
description: Query output structs still use plain time.Time for time fields. These are functionally correct because consumers use timeconv.TimePtrToJstRFC3339 for formatting (which handles UTC→JST). Converting to gormtype would be a consistency improvement. The datasource models already use gormtype (they were converted earlier). Deferred full scan struct conversion as a future incremental task.
